data.title: Payment reminder from MusterFit Studios – returned direct debit
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH sent a reminder (Mahnung) because the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee was returned by your bank. You owe €47.40 (€39.90 fee plus €7.50 reminder fee) by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your bank returned the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee, so the gym is asking you to pay the open amount by transfer. The total is €47.40, including a €7.50 reminder fee that covers the bank's returned-debit charge. Pay by 12 December 2025 to the IBAN shown. If you have already paid, the letter says to treat it as settled. Check that your bank account has enough funds for future debits. If you think the reminder fee is wrong, contact the gym.
